Short title and commencement.—(1) These rules may be called the Department of Industrial Policy and Promotion, Departmental Canteen (Group ‘C’ posts) Recruitment (Amendment) Rules, 2017. (2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 2. In the Department of Industrial Policy and Promotion, Departmental Canteen (Group ‘C’ posts) Recruitment Rules, 2013 (herein after referred to as the said rules), for rule 2, the following rule shall be substituted, namely:- “2. Number of posts, classification, level in the pay matrix or pay scale.- The number of posts, their classification, level in the pay matrix or pay scale attached thereto shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the Schedule annexed to these rules.”. 3. In the said rules, in the Schedule, - (i) against serial number 1 relating to the post of ‘Assistant Manager- cum- Storekeeper’,- (a) in column (4),- (A) for the heading, the following heading shall be substituted, namely:- “Level in the pay matrix or pay scale.”; (B) for the entry, the following entry shall be substituted, namely:- “Level 4 in the pay matrix ` 25500-81100.”; (b) in column (11),- (A) under the sub-heading ‘Promotion’,- I for items (i) and (ii), the following items shall be substituted, namely:- “ (i) clerks with eight years regular service in level 2 in the pay matrix ` 19900- 63200; (ii) Halwai-cum-Cook with five years regular service in level 3 in the pay matrix ` 21700-69100 with two years’ experience in handling stores or accounts and possessing educational qualification as prescribed for direct recruited Clerk that is 12th Class pass with Commerce as a subject from a recognized Board.”; II Note 2 shall be omitted; (B) under the sub-heading ‘Deputation’,- I. in item (a), for sub-item (ii), the following sub-item shall be substituted, namely:- “ (ii) with eight years’ service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on a regular basis in level 2 in the pay matrix ` 19900- 63200 or equivalent in the parent cadre or department.”; II. Note 3 shall be omitted; (ii) against serial number 2, relating to the post of ‘Halwai-cum-Cook’,- (a) in column (4) for the entry, the following entry shall be substituted, namely:- “Level 3 in the pay matrix ` 21700-69100.”; (b) in column (11),- -- 4 of 6 -- [Hkkx II—[k.M 3(i)] Hkkjr dk jkti=k % flrEcj 23] 2017@vkf'ou 1] 1939 1393 (A) under the sub-heading ‘Promotion’,- I. for the entries, the following entries shall be substituted, namely:- “Assistant Halwai-cum-Cook with three years’ regular service in level 2 in the pay matrix ` 19900- 63200.”; II. A two week training on organizational behavior, communication skill and accounting practices shall be mandatory for the Canteen Attendants for promotion to the post of clerk from Insttitute of Secretariat Training and Management or any other recognized Institutes.”; II. A trade skill test shall be conducted by the Departmental Promotion Committee for cooking including maintenance of hygiene, etc., to assess the suitability of the candidate for promotion.”; II. Note 3 shall be omitted; (v) against serial number 5 relating to the post of ‘Canteen Attendant’, in column (4) for the entry, the following entry shall be substituted, namely:- “Level 1 in the pay matrix ` 18000- 56900.”.
